nodes.label: pnpm Monorepo Layout
nodes.rationale: backend (NestJS), frontend (Next.js Pages Router) and packages/contracts are pnpm workspaces sharing tsconfig.base.json. Requires Node 20+ and pnpm 9+. Root scripts (pnpm dev / build / test / db:seed / typecheck) fan out across workspaces.

nodes.label: NestJS Backend Architecture
nodes.rationale: Module-per-domain NestJS API (auth, billing, entitlement, schemas, scripts) on port 8000 with Swagger docs at /api/docs. This supersedes the earlier Express server.js architecture described in PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md and AI_SERVICES_GUIDE.md.

nodes.label: Entitlement System
nodes.rationale: Feature gating by subscription plan expressed declaratively via the @RequireEntitlement decorator plus EntitlementGuard, rather than imperative plan checks in each handler. Three entitlement kinds — boolean (on/off), limit (usage counter with monthly reset, incrementUsage:true), and tier (hierarchical requiredValue) — cover all gating cases. Adding one means editing seed.ts and re-running pnpm db:seed.

nodes.label: @RequireEntitlement Decorator
nodes.rationale: Declares featureKey, optional incrementUsage and requiredValue on a controller method; enforced at request time by EntitlementGuard alongside JwtAuthGuard.

nodes.label: EntitlementGuard
nodes.rationale: NestJS guard that reads @RequireEntitlement metadata, checks the user's plan entitlement, and increments usage counters when configured.

nodes.label: Subscription Plan Tiers
nodes.rationale: Four tiers gate escalating automation: Free $0 (5 applications/month, 1 resume), Pro $29 (AI features, 50 applications/month), Elite $99 (human agent, unlimited applications), Interview $149 (dedicated coach, interview prep).

nodes.label: Stripe Billing Integration
nodes.rationale: Products/prices live in the Stripe Dashboard; the backend exposes checkout, portal, cancel and a webhook at POST /api/billing/webhook handling checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted, and invoice.payment_succeeded/failed. Subscription state is driven by webhooks rather than polled.

nodes.label: JWT Access/Refresh Token Flow
nodes.rationale: Short-lived access token (15 min) in an httpOnly cookie plus a 7-day refresh token. Short access-token TTL limits blast radius of theft; httpOnly storage blocks XSS exfiltration. Note this conflicts with OAUTH_SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md, which describes the JWT being stored in localStorage.
